items.html: It follows that Atik and his Nukva, and Arich Anpin and his Nukva, are Neshama, and they are three heads. After them, AVI and Yeshsut are Ruach, and they are three heads. After them, ZON, and Jacob and Leah, are Nefesh, and they are three heads. And this is what is said in the Idra, p. 289: “And they are corrected, just as Atika Kadisha is crowned with three heads, so are they all in three heads.”
